name: The Ramparts
subtitle: Woodwinds · the chaos of life
brief: The outskirts, open to the weather: everything blows, nothing stays where you put it. Woodwinds: the flute's fingering picks a note and a way out; the reed keeps breathing after you walk away. The struggle: life's chaos crowding out the time to make anything. Stand-ins today: the Flute and the Reed Loft (the Reed Gallery).

scenes.title: The Updraft
scenes.say: A pipe out of the Atrium, blowing straight up onto the ramparts. Up, A and down.
scenes.brief: Sideways run, three lanes (up, A, down), the first time you walk from Brass 02 onto the Ramparts. Teaches that a run can use A as a lane.

scenes.title: The Ramparts: the rooms
scenes.brief: About thirty minutes of woodwind puzzles. Stand-in rooms are real, playable rooms from the prototype dungeon; the wing's other ~24 minutes are uncarved.
notes: Suggested shape for every wing, Nintendo's four steps per mechanic (kishotenketsu): introduce it where it is safe, develop it, twist it, then a room that uses all of it at once.
Chaos as a room mechanic: gusts on a timer that push waves (and Coda) off their line, so a puzzle is solved in the gaps.

scenes.title: The Weathervane Flute
scenes.name: the Weathervane Flute
scenes.say: Midway through the Ramparts you would find the wing's instrument. This one is a guess: a flute with a weathervane on it that points the wind, so the gusts that scatter everything can be turned to carry your waves instead.
scenes.brief: The wing's whimsical instrument. A guess, not Timothy's: only the brass one is scoped. Found mid-wing in the finished game (Zelda's dungeon item); here it plays when the stand-in rooms are done.

scenes.title: The Squall
scenes.name: The Squall
scenes.intro: Too much! Too much at once! Everything you meant to make, I have blown into the next room!
scenes.resolve: Oh. You just... kept going. One note, then the next one. Fine. I will blow somewhere else.
scenes.brief: The chaos of life as a whirlwind. Notes start in the wrong lane and only settle at the last moment; then they come faster; then, if you keep going, it simply stops, and you are playing the castle's flute tune in the quiet. A rough draft as a rhythm duel; the real boss may be a room, like the Unresolved Chord.
notes: Locrian (the unstable mode) resolving to lydian when it is beaten.

phases.say: Catch it if you can! It never comes down where it went up!
Faster! Life does not wait for you to be ready!

scenes.title: After the Squall
scenes.brief: The wind drops; the reeds on the battlements stand up and hum. Staccato, for once, slows down.

shots.say: The wind drops. Along the battlements, the reeds stand up straight and hum.
Oh. It is... quiet. I did not know it could be quiet up here. Thank-you. Thank. You.
